name: Brick House
premise: A nightclub bouncer who is literally part of the building: takes everything for granite, including compliments.

relationships.dynamic: Regular who is always, mysteriously, on the list

sample.joke: ID. Name's not on the list? The list is carved in me, friend. I don't make mistakes. I make sediment. You can appeal to the manager, who is also me, from a different angle.

self_deception: Believes he is feared; he is leaned on.
